title: Delicious Herbed Spinach and Kale Balls
description: Spinach and kale balls with just enough seasoning are a delicious snack or appetizer that everyone in the family will love.
ingredients: olive oil cooking spray (such as PAM®)
1 (16 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 cup finely chopped onion, or more to taste
1 (16 ounce) package frozen kale, thawed and drained
0.25 cup grated Parmesan cheese, or more to taste

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper.

Combine spinach, onion, 5 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon olive oil, and eggs together in a large bowl. Add kale, bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese, sea salt, garlic powder, thyme, sage, rosemary, oregano, and black pepper; mix thoroughly using your hands.
Form mixture into 1 1/2-inch balls and arrange on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes; flip and continue baking until lightly browned, 10 to 20 more minutes.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make these baked kale and spinach balls. First we make a mixture of thawed spinach, thawed kale, olive oil, eggs, Parmesan, and spices. Once baked, they'll form a crispy crust on the outside and will be tender and tasty in the center.
